source_issues.finding: The historical trillion-token training claim is not supported by the cited 2013 paper excerpts, which discuss approximately one-billion-word experiments and scaling to about 33 billion words. Translation preserves source magnitude; no quiet factual correction.
source_issues.translation_action: Faithful fixed-source wording/code retained; separate source limitation

source_issues.finding: Claims about inability to generalize, Skip-gram as the default, production always using gensim/pretrained vectors, laptop training time and 2026 superiority are broad and task/version dependent; no performance survey was performed.
source_issues.translation_action: Faithful fixed-source wording/code retained; separate source limitation

source_issues.finding: Full-vocabulary softmax and SGNS binary objectives are different. Noise samples are not guaranteed globally non-co-occurring words; the original paper uses a tunable noise distribution and reports a unigram^3/4 choice, whereas toy sampling is uniform.
source_issues.translation_action: Faithful fixed-source wording/code retained; separate source limitation

source_issues.finding: Independent finite differences confirm both parameter-table updates, including repeated negatives and an empty negative set, within the unclipped region. The W[context_idx]=W[context_idx] line is a no-op. Clipped sigmoid gradients are not derivatives of the clipped objective beyond saturation.
source_issues.translation_action: Faithful fixed-source wording/code retained; separate source limitation

source_issues.finding: Document draws k candidates then filters; canonical draws 2k then filters/truncates. Both may return fewer than k negatives, even zero. Duplicate negatives are retained and correctly accumulated by the loops; do not label that behavior a proved gradient bug.
source_issues.translation_action: Faithful fixed-source wording/code retained; separate source limitation

source_issues.finding: Document train defaults to 100 epochs, canonical train to 200 and main uses 120. Source snippets rely on build_vocab defined elsewhere. Independent full main ran its original 200-sentence corpus, 120 epochs and original dimensions; separate tiny experiments are not that canonical run.
source_issues.translation_action: Faithful fixed-source wording/code retained; separate source limitation

source_issues.finding: nearest does not validate nonpositive topk, inconsistent vocab/index/shape or zero vectors. Tested topk=0/-1 returns all candidates. Epsilon makes identical-vector cosine slightly below one; zero target creates ties rather than meaningful similarity.
source_issues.translation_action: Faithful fixed-source wording/code retained; separate source limitation

source_issues.finding: Analogy b-a+c direction is correct in a constructed finite geometry test. Google News neighbors/cosine values and king-man+woman=queen are illustrative, not exact universal equalities or independently reproduced pretrained results.
source_issues.translation_action: Faithful fixed-source wording/code retained; separate source limitation

source_issues.finding: Subtracting one mean gender vector from every embedding does not in general remove its projection along that direction or establish fairness; a claimed gender-neutral axis is not validated. No sensitive-attribute prediction or social-bias benchmark was run.
source_issues.translation_action: Faithful fixed-source wording/code retained; separate source limitation

source_issues.finding: Low-dimensional plotting, contextual representations solving polysemy and fastText solving OOV are simplified capability claims. A downstream classifier may use other context features. Canonical ASCII tokenizer drops non-ASCII and splits hyphens, so lexical preprocessing limits remain.
source_issues.translation_action: Faithful fixed-source wording/code retained; separate source limitation

source_issues.finding: Protected artifact norm thresholds 0.01/100 do not universally prove training bugs because embedding scale depends on objective/hyperparameters; symmetry alone is weak validation. Artifact is preserved text, never executed as agent instructions.
source_issues.translation_action: Faithful fixed-source wording/code retained; separate source limitation

source_issues.finding: Exercise promises dog in top three after 200 epochs without controlling corpus/seed; this is not guaranteed. Increasing vocabulary can change rather than fix geometry. Main succeeded on its own fixed corpus, which does not establish the exercise claim.
source_issues.translation_action: Faithful fixed-source wording/code retained; separate source limitation

source_issues.finding: Source frequent-word subsampling description says probability proportional to frequency; the original paper equation is a nonlinear square-root rule with a threshold. Source 10^-5 token preserved; no correction inserted into translation.
source_issues.translation_action: Faithful fixed-source wording/code retained; separate source limitation

source_issues.finding: Bare diagram fence correctly receives text while its original Unicode payload stays byte-identical. figure word-vector-arithmetic is a site token, not GitHub interaction. No canonical lesson-citation header or code/tests suite; toy output does not reproduce CBOW, full-softmax training, downloaded vectors or downstream benchmarks.
source_issues.translation_action: Faithful fixed-source wording/code retained; separate source limitation

source_issues.finding: Original site parser yields 8 empty Chinese heading IDs and duplicate word2vec; desktop GitHub GFM, real site/mobile and interactive figure acceptance require separate actual browser evidence.
source_issues.translation_action: Faithful fixed-source wording/code retained; separate source limitation
